notes.title: OUT NOW - American Election Simulator
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3149960/American_Election_Simulator/]American Election Simulator[/url] is NOW RELEASED,  exclusively on Steam!

This version has been rebuilt using the core mechanics of the simulation engine from the previous version. Plot your way through an American political campaign as you go head-to-head against a rival political party. Make tough decisions as you travel across the country and try to earn enough votes to become the next President of the United States!

[b]What's New in American Election Simulator?[/b]

Due to popular demand, we've integrated many new features that our community has requested. Every decision that you make will impact the political map in real-time. Our card-based strategy system allows you to campaign using many different strategies.

Want to play it safe and hold your own political rallies? Or would you rather face off in policy debates and improve your approval ratings enough to swing the election in your favor? Keep track of your campaign's progress by conducting state polls and launching campaign advertisements in battleground states.

When the campaign is over, you can experience the intense swings of an American election night. View election results in real-time as the votes are tabulated and watch the results come in for all fifty states throughout the night.

[b]New Features To Be Excited About[/b]

We have tons of new features and have add layers of depth to the campaign system. Every move that you make will impact your approval ratings and could shift the election. Use action cards and policy cards to narrowly win states, while monitoring your opponent's actions on every turn.

[list]
[*] Card-Based Strategy System Built From the Ground Up
[*] Interactive Policy Debates against your Political Rival
[*] An Interactive Strategy Map that Updates In Real-Time After Every Campaign Move
[*] Customize Your Own Political Candidate
[*] Real-Time Election Night Simulation
[*] Steam Leaderboards and Achievements
[/list]
